ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Entertaining Ideas
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.96
42 new recreation buildings, one for nearly every rung of the tech ladder, so a colony always has something worth doing - whether it is chewing pemmican in a hide tent or running an archotech lounge.
RimWorld 1.5 and 1.6. No new research: everything gates on projects the game already has. No Harmony, no dependencies, and safe to add to an existing save. Things animate while they are being used - pinball balls fly, arcade screens play, fish swim, sacks arc through the air.
TRIBAL AND MEDIEVAL - no power, no research - Knucklebone mat - the thinking game a tribe can build on day one. - Seed pit board - mancala, carved for a tribe. No chairs? They sit on the ground. - Storyteller's stump - one colonist tells a story beside a campfire; the rest gather round, and the story takes shape in the smoke. - Shadow lantern theater - a lamp, a linen screen and a drum the flame turns by itself. - Soaking tub - a wood-fired barrel colonists climb into. Warms the room and steams while lit. - Hammock - rest that is not a bed. Hangs from a wall or a column at each end. - Skittles lane - the pins stay down until somebody walks over and stands them back up. - Cornhole - one board, a throwing line, two players taking turns. - Lawn noughts and crosses - a rope grid on the grass, played with thrown bean bags. - Jigsaw table - a puzzle that stays where it was left, finished over several sittings, then framed and hung on a wall. - Board game table - five games in the cupboard: Colonists of the Rim, Raid!, Orbital Trader, Caravan Routes and Muffalo & Thrumbo. Up to four players. - Table tennis, giant four-in-a-row and a tangle mat. - Armillary sphere - brass rings turning on their own clockwork.
INDUSTRIAL - Four pinball tables, each with a painted backglass and climbing score reels. - Three cocktail arcade tables - ORE RUSH, THRUMBO! and INFESTATION! - with chip-tune sound and a title screen when idle. - Karaoke machine - the room judges the singer, and being well liked covers for being terrible. - Swimming pool - painted as terrain in any shape; the filter claims every tile joined to it. - Aquarium, air hockey, massage chair, heated tub, bowling lane, and two clockwork orreries.
FITNESS - Trampoline, punching bag, weight bench, exercise bike and bouldering wall. Colonists really bounce, climb and pedal; the bag swings where it is hit, the bike feeds the power grid, and a proper session leaves them feeling they have worked out.
SPACER AND ULTRA - Vista panels, 1 to 3 tiles wide, hung on a wall - dawn, daylight, sunset and stars on the local clock, easing cabin fever. - Hologame pod, dreamloop holotheater and gravball court.
GOOD TO KNOW - Electric games can break down like a television and need a component to repair. - The jigsaw and board game tables seat as many players as there are chairs at their sides. - Dubs Bad Hygiene and Vanilla Furniture Expanded are optional. With them, the tubs and the pool can be plumbed in and the comfort furniture moves onto VFE's research. Load order does not matter, with or without them. - The build number shows in the mod list. Please include it with any bug report.
